items.text:
For every good thing this game has going for it, it hinges comepletely on the player to not break the fragile mess this game is. 
The whole Oooh you are poor and have a lot of debt! Thing is going out the window after MAYBE 3rd salvage run if you are very unlucky.
Everything takes AGES to do, it's one of those games you can just leave running and go do something else while your guy/guys are fixing stuff up or whatever else as it takes so long. 
Almost and i mean like 60% of game's content is not explained and a lot of key features are straight up left unexplained, leaving you wasting hours getting a hang of core mechanics such as Long distance travel.
 
Orbital navigation is straight up obysmal. I grew up on KSP and THAT game is 3d, and this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information. 
Aside from salvaging, which is something you always have to start with, there is mining, how do i know that? Because some documentation explains how to do that? Nope, it's because some dude is selling mining gear and how do i know how to mine? I guess better go to the discord! 

But that's not the main problem. Even in the KitFox advert they show that the entire game world is broken. You can just dock to people's ships, uninstall their fuel tanks and haul them back on your ship and nobody bats an eye. You can just break every station by just uninstalling the walls or just opening every airlock, killing everyone. I have to restrain myself because nobody will stop you from breaking the game, leaving you with just making money on repeat. 

And after all that this game comes out of early access? I regret buying this years ago thinking they will make something better.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏虽然有种种优点，但一切都完全取决于玩家不去破坏这个脆弱不堪的烂摊子。
所谓“哦你好穷啊还欠了一屁股债！”的设定，在你大概第三次打捞任务之后（如果你特别倒霉的话）就彻底形同虚设了。
做什么事都要花上老半天，这就是那种你可以直接让它挂着运行、自己去干别的事的游戏，因为你的角色/角色们修理东西或干其他什么事都要花太长时间。
游戏内容里几乎——我是说大约60%——都没有解释，很多关键功能干脆就完全没说明，让你白白浪费好几个小时才摸清核心机制，比如远距离航行。

轨道导航简直糟糕透顶。我是玩KSP长大的，那游戏可是3D的，而这款游戏想尽办法让轨道导航和机动操作感觉迟钝、别扭、信息匮乏。
除了打捞——这是你永远都得先做的事——还有采矿，我怎么知道有采矿的？因为有哪份文档解释了怎么采矿吗？没有，是因为有个家伙在卖采矿装备，那我又怎么知道怎么采矿？我猜最好还是去Discord问问吧！

但这还不是主要问题。就连KitFox的广告里都展示了整个游戏世界是崩坏的。你可以直接对接别人的飞船，拆下他们的燃料箱拖回自己船上，没人会眨一下眼。你可以直接拆掉墙壁或打开所有气闸来破坏每一个空间站，杀死所有人。我得克制自己，因为没人会阻止你破坏游戏，结果你就只能一遍遍重复赚钱。

经历了这一切之后，这游戏居然还脱离了抢先体验？我真后悔几年前买下它，还以为他们会做出更好的东西。

observations.description: 轨道导航感觉不响应、难以操作且缺乏信息。
observations.evidence: this game does everything to make orbital navigation and maneuvers feel unresponsive, finicky and lacking in information
observations.evidence_zh: 这款游戏想尽一切办法让轨道导航和机动操作感觉迟钝、别扭且缺乏信息。

items.text:
[i]Very[/i] unfriendly tutorial. I was excited my the idea of this game but there's so much visual noise immediately. My feedback would be to lock away some of the complexity and drip feed it to a new player. 

The concept is so nice and I imagine once you have a deep understanding of everything, it's probably enjoyable. 
But most new players will likely be put off by the first 30 minutes, as I was. 

I felt there was a depth of play available but it was concealed behind a lot of frustrating elements.

Couple of other bits of feedback. The click to select on the Nav Station doesn't feel user friendly. Click and drag should be considered movement, clicking to move the frame was confusing. Especially as it kept locking the camera back to the crosshairs. It's also really not apparent which is your ship to a new player, in relation to anything. 
Names of things are also hidden if scrolled out, so it took a while to realise ONKG (sp) was hidden under a stack of names of things. Could be solved through a stack display accessible through hover or click of the mouse.
items.text_zh:
[i]非常[/i]不友好的教程。我本来对这款游戏的想法很兴奋，但立刻就有太多视觉噪音。我的反馈是，应该把一些复杂性锁起来，并逐步喂给新玩家。 

这个概念非常好，我想一旦你对一切都有了深入理解，它大概会很好玩。 
但大多数新玩家很可能会像我一样，被前30分钟劝退。 

我觉得游戏中有可玩的深度，但它被许多令人沮丧的元素掩盖了。

还有几点其他反馈。在导航站上点击选择感觉并不友好。点击并拖动应该被视为移动，点击来移动框架令人困惑。尤其是它还总是把镜头锁回准星。对于新玩家来说，也真的很不明显哪艘是你的飞船，以及它与其他任何东西的关系。 
如果缩小视野，物品名称也会被隐藏，所以我过了一阵子才意识到ONKG（原文如此）被藏在一堆物品名称下面。也许可以通过悬停或鼠标点击访问的堆叠显示来解决。

observations.description: 导航站点击选择不友好，点击拖动被当作移动，点击移动框架令人困惑
observations.evidence: The click to select on the Nav Station doesn't feel user friendly. Click and drag should be considered movement, clicking to move the frame was confusing.
observations.evidence_zh: 在导航站上点击选择感觉并不友好。点击并拖动应该被视为移动，点击来移动框架令人困惑。

items.text:
got overwhelmed by the game's crapload of unique mechanics at the start of my first character, decided to punch a sleeping woman to death instead

update:

My prior review doesn't do justice for Ostranauts, as it understandably has a steep learning curve that needs you to go through at least a single playthrough and lots of reading for guides and tutorials. On my fourth playthrough, having spent 10 hours on getting a grasp on this game (and yet theres still a lot to learn), I decided to edit this review with a proper cricitism and praise Ostranauts deserves.

Getting into this for the first time, especially if you're the kind of person that's obtuse (im one), you're going to get thrown off trying to figure out what to do and eventually get discouraged from playing it further. Deaths from suffocating without oxygen, crashing your ship to someone's, or getting stabbed by pirates (havent experienced this one yet), you'll be tempted to leave this game be and reconsider if it was worth the purchase you did. Even if you haven't died yet in Ostranauts, the complex controls and mechanics you need to learn can be one of the main reasons new players might not play this again.

That's normal! It takes time for some people to take a liking to Ostranauts and play it as it's intended. The game does its best to hold your hand for a good reason, through in-game tutorials that you can follow through every time you launch a new playthrough. The game doesn't expects you to be proficient in everything Ostranauts has to offer, as you will eventually learn everything later in your playthroughs. The humble player community of Ostranauts is friendly too, with many veterans eager to help out new players.

The lore of Ostranauts is absolutely amazing to delve into, carving out the essence Ostranauts makes it out to be. There isn't much to be done for your character's lore though (in gameplay at least), albeit I don't consider it as a flaw of Ostranauts because you're the one to carve out your own story. 

Unlike NEO Scavenger (hello neo scav fans), playing Ostranauts can be incredibly time-intensive. If you think NEO Scavenger wasn't casual, Ostranauts' gameplay will make you think otherwise.

Take your time, be patient, and you'll soon grow to love this game just like how you would love NEO Scavenger.

ps: It's highly recommended that you join player communities of Ostranauts and refer to guides a lot, just so you wouldn't have to go through the phase of frequently quitting Ostranauts over your frustration with it, like me.
items.text_zh:
在第一个角色开局时被游戏一大堆独特的机制搞得不知所措，决定转而把一个熟睡的女人打死

更新：

我先前的评测对《Ostranauts》并不公平，因为它可以理解地有着陡峭的学习曲线，需要你至少完整通关一次，并阅读大量指南和教程。在我的第四次游玩中，在花了10个小时来掌握这款游戏之后（而且仍然有很多要学），我决定编辑这篇评测，给出《Ostranauts》应得的恰当批评与赞扬。

第一次接触这款游戏时，尤其是如果你是那种迟钝的人（我就是），你会被搞得晕头转向，试图弄清楚该做什么，最终会灰心丧气，不想再玩下去。因没有氧气而窒息死亡、把你的飞船撞到别人的飞船上，或者被海盗捅死（这个我还没经历过），你会忍不住想放下这款游戏，重新考虑这次购买是否值得。即使你还没有在《Ostranauts》中死过，你需要学习的复杂操作和机制也可能是新玩家不再玩这款游戏的主要原因之一。

这很正常！有些人需要时间才能喜欢上《Ostranauts》，并按照它应有的方式去玩。游戏尽力牵着你的手是有充分理由的，通过游戏内教程，你每次开始新游玩时都可以跟着走。游戏并不指望你精通《Ostranauts》所提供的一切，因为你最终会在游玩过程中学会一切。谦逊的《Ostranauts》玩家社区也很友好，许多老玩家都热心帮助新玩家。

《Ostranauts》的背景设定绝对值得深入探究，雕琢出了《Ostranauts》所呈现的精髓。不过，你的角色的背景设定并没有太多可做的（至少在玩法上），尽管我不认为这是《Ostranauts》的缺陷，因为你自己就是雕琢自己故事的人。

与《NEO Scavenger》不同（你好，NEO Scav粉丝们），玩《Ostranauts》可能会极其耗时。如果你觉得《NEO Scavenger》不算休闲，那么《Ostranauts》的玩法会让你改变想法。

慢慢来，保持耐心，你很快就会爱上这款游戏，就像你会爱上《NEO Scavenger》一样。

附言：强烈建议你加入《Ostranauts》的玩家社区并多多参考指南，这样你就不必像我一样经历因挫败而频繁弃玩《Ostranauts》的阶段。

observations.description: 复杂的操控和机制需要学习，可能让新玩家不愿再玩
observations.evidence: the complex controls and mechanics you need to learn can be one of the main reasons new players might not play this again
observations.evidence_zh: 你需要学习的复杂操作和机制，可能是新玩家不会再玩这个游戏的主要原因之一

items.text:
This has the worst UI I've seen in years. It is tiring to play this.

The way you interact with things is unintuitive. The way you fly your ship is unintuitive. You start out the game with a proximity warning blaring in your ears and your ship in a fierce spin. I've got a headache right now after trying that.

The tutorial is also really bad. The character creation part does looks interesting but you're not really told what anything does, so you're just kind of flailing around.

I'd wait quite a while before picking this up and see what gets done with it.
items.text_zh:
这是我多年来见过的最糟糕的UI。玩这个让人很累。

你与事物互动的方式不直观。你驾驶飞船的方式不直观。你开始游戏时，耳边响着 proximity 警告的刺耳声，飞船在剧烈旋转。试过之后我现在头疼。

教程也非常糟糕。角色创建部分看起来确实有趣，但并没有真正告诉你任何东西是做什么的，所以你只能瞎折腾。

我会等相当长一段时间再入手这个，看看它会被做成什么样。

observations.description: 与物体交互的方式不直观。
observations.evidence: The way you interact with things is unintuitive.
observations.evidence_zh: 你和事物互动的方式很不直观。

items.text:
I played a ton of Neo Scavenger, and I really liked it a lot, so I bought this game based on that and the description. It's still early access so maybe this will change as time goes on, but this game is utterly unplayable. Do NOT buy this game based on your enjoyment of Neo Scavenger or other similar games.

I don't have high expectations for a niche indie game in early access, but this is really really bad. Neo Scavenger already suffered from terrible UI, but  Ostranauts somehow made it so much worse. Every single thing you do is a pain, not because it's difficult, but because it's cumbersome. If you've ever tried walking around your house with your eyes closed, or using only your non-dominant hand, that is what playing this game is like.

I cannot describe how badly the ship navigation controls in this game are designed and explained. I've been playing PC games since Zork, and for the life of me I cannot think of a single worse design example. Dwarf Fortress is easier to play than this game, and has better UI.

I do not write reviews often and I cannot warn you strongly enough how bad it is in terms of UI and controls. I want to stress that I am no stranger to playing these types of games, weird hot keys, keyboard only, hilariously bad parser interface, these are all things I can handle, I do not mind trial and error or punishing difficulty, but this games navigation is like trying driving a car in a nightmare where nothing works right even though you know how to drive.
items.text_zh:
我玩了大量的《Neo Scavenger》，而且非常喜欢，所以基于这一点以及游戏描述，我买了这款游戏。它仍处于抢先体验阶段，所以也许随着时间推移这会改变，但这款游戏完全没法玩。不要因为喜欢《Neo Scavenger》或其他类似游戏就买这款游戏。

我对抢先体验阶段的小众独立游戏没有很高的期望，但这真的真的非常糟糕。《Neo Scavenger》已经饱受糟糕UI之苦，但《Ostranauts》不知怎么把它弄得糟糕得多。你做的每一件事都很痛苦，不是因为难，而是因为笨重。如果你曾经试过闭着眼睛在家里走动，或者只用非惯用手做事，那就是玩这款游戏的感觉。

我无法形容这款游戏里的飞船导航控制设计得和解释得有多糟糕。我从《Zork》时代就开始玩PC游戏，而我死活想不出哪怕一个更糟糕的设计例子。《Dwarf Fortress》都比这款游戏更容易玩，而且UI更好。

我不常写评测，而我再怎么强烈警告你它在UI和控制方面有多糟糕都不为过。我想强调，我绝不是不熟悉玩这类游戏的人，奇怪的热键、纯键盘操作、糟糕得好笑的解析器界面，这些都是我能应付的东西，我不介意反复试错或惩罚性的难度，但这款游戏的导航就像在噩梦里开车，明明你会开车，却什么都不正常。

observations.description: 飞船导航操控设计极差且缺乏说明
observations.evidence: I cannot describe how badly the ship navigation controls in this game are designed and explained
observations.evidence_zh: 我无法形容这款游戏中的飞船导航控制设计和解说得有多糟糕
